sensor_intake.source_domain: University of Ottawa laboratory bearing rig, not a pump or mining machine
sensor_intake.selected: H/I/O/B only; four fault classes × four speed profiles × three trials

sensor.source_domain: University of Ottawa laboratory bearing rig, not a pump or mining machine
sensor.selection: 48 source runs: four classes × four speed profiles × three trials
sensor.split: A and B speed-profile recordings train; disjoint C and D recordings test; score one averaged prediction per complete recording
limitations: Separate whole recordings are held out, but the dataset does not document independent physical bearing specimens for every trial/profile.
The rig is not a pump; transfer to pump support bearings is a mechanical-component analogy, not demonstrated pump accuracy.
No sensor recording is paired with an XJTU event-camera run; only the four fault labels are comparable.
The target is present fault type, not future repair timing or remaining useful life.

camera.selection: 48 released recordings: four classes × two speeds × six camera configurations
camera.preprocessing: event polarity counts at 64×48, signed log contrast, OpenCV 64×64 HOG
camera.split: all 20 Hz recordings train; all 30 Hz recordings test; evaluate by recording, averaging frame probabilities
limitations: Event frames show bearing-housing motion; they are not RGB photographs of visible damage.
Both speeds come from one laboratory pump rig, not independent mining pumps.
Only the first two seconds of each recording were processed; ZIP-member CRC was not verified from the full member.
Sensor and event recordings are from different rigs and are compared by fault taxonomy, not paired sample or fused prediction.
The four-class target describes current condition, not time-to-repair or remaining useful life.

original_xlsx_diagnostic.independent_run_accuracy_reason: One sensor recording per class; no independent fault run can be held out.
original_xlsx_diagnostic.dataset: Mendeley 10.17632/63gjxpn7s6.1; four selected single-condition vibration files
original_xlsx_diagnostic.split: first 60% train, middle 20% unused gap, final 20% test within each source file
limitations: Only one source recording per class: test windows share the same physical run as training windows.
These metrics are a pipeline smoke test, not independent-pump/fault generalization or deployment accuracy.
No visual data are trained here; XJTU-DV-Pump event recordings remain remote and are not paired with these samples.
This classifies an existing condition; it does not predict a future repair time or remaining useful life.

uci_hydraulic.dataset: UCI Condition monitoring of hydraulic systems
uci_hydraulic.provenance: Experimental hydraulic test rig; not mining-machine telemetry
uci_hydraulic.task: Three-class current pump-leakage condition (none, weak, severe); not future repair prediction
uci_hydraulic.feature_method: Per-cycle mean, standard deviation, RMS and range for each of 17 channels
uci_hydraulic.split_method: StratifiedGroupKFold; hold out complete combinations of cooler, valve, pump and accumulator conditions
uci_hydraulic.selection_rule: Maximum validation macro F1 among logistic regression and random forest
limitations: One controlled test rig; no independent mining-equipment validation.
Rows are operating cycles, not separate physical machines.
Condition labels are contemporaneous; there is no future maintenance outcome or RUL target.

espset.provenance: Real offshore oil-production pumps; not mining pumps
espset.task: Current abnormal-vs-normal pump vibration condition; not future failure or RUL
espset.split_method: Two-stage GroupShuffleSplit by esp_id; no pump appears in more than one split
espset.selection_rule: Maximum validation macro F1, then abnormal recall
limitations: Only 11 source pumps; holdout performance is sensitive to which pumps are chosen.
The source is offshore oil production, not mining; transfer must be tested on mining pumps.
These seven features were supplied by the publisher; spectrum.zip was not required for this first baseline.
No timestamps, images, future repairs or remaining-useful-life labels are present in features.csv.
